title: The Wisdom of the Loudest: A Large-Scale Audit of Generative Search on Reddit

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing selection rates of Reddit comments based on platform-visible structural signals like upvote score percentiles, top-level status, and posting age using conditional logistic regressions.

Using LIWC and transformer-based classifiers to measure and compare the presence of experiential voice, formality, and directive language between unselected comments, selected comments, and the final synthesized AI answers.
Examining cross-community information routing by measuring the relationship between a source community's subscriber count and the size of the communities retrieved to synthesize the answer.
